certification: none; no OS build is certified

probes.mechanism: os.replace + os.fsync on a local temp file
probes.detail: rename replaced target contents atomically at the application-visible level; this does NOT test crash or power-loss durability
byte-range lock acquired and released; does not establish exit-time release under forced termination
monotonic reading is non-decreasing; monotonic vs boottime semantics not tested
child process exit status observed; this is 'process exited', not 'execution settled'

destructive_not_run.reason: descendant escape/containment; requires a disposable approved scope
parent death before registration; requires forced process kills
atomic-replace crash durability; requires crash/power-loss target
disk full/quota between write and flush; destructive to the host
memory pressure/OOM; destructive to the host
supervisor restart race with forced kills
suspend/resume across a deadline; requires controllable power state
network-storage interruption; requires an approved network mount
